The renewal experiment injects a semantic expired-token response inside one bounded synchronous rclone process. That failed call must remain failed; only a later call may obtain and use the replacement session token. This is not OAuth refresh, elapsed-time expiry or automatic retry evidence.

The saved expiry is bounded against the observed grant interval. A fresh child must read the same synthetic member using the saved replacement token without a new grant or discovery; its config bytes must remain unchanged. This establishes clean-exit persistence only, not atomic multi-setting saves or power-loss durability.
